one_line: Last great Gahadavala king of Kannauj and Varanasi, who fell defending his realm against the Ghurid advance at Chandawar in 1194 CE.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, tall and solidly built with the bearing of a seasoned commander-king.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, warm medium-brown North Indian complexion, sharp dark-brown eyes under slightly arched brows, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing the jaw, default expression calm and resolute with a hint of sadness.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair gathered into a low, compact knot at the back of the head, mostly hidden under a plain, close-fitting maroon cloth turban wrapped flat with no tall peak, a narrow gold band stitched along the turban’s lower edge.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 12th-century North Indian royal-warrior attire: a knee-length quilted cotton coat (padded kaftan-like tunic) dyed deep indigo with subtle vertical stitching, worn over a long-sleeved cream-coloured cotton kurta; a broad crimson patka-sash wrapped firmly around the waist with its ends hanging to the left hip; straight, ankle-length off-white cotton trousers; on top, a fitted mail shirt suggested by a fine grey scale pattern visible at sleeves and skirt beneath the quilted coat, and a simple polished steel breast-plate strapped over the chest; plain but sturdy brown leather boots reaching mid-calf; minimal jewellery—small gold stud earrings, a single thin gold neck-chain just visible at the collar, and a practical iron signet ring on his right hand—balancing royal status with battlefield readiness.
appearance.signature: A long steel straight-bladed sword (khanda-like) with a slightly widening tip, simple iron cross-guard and disc pommel, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with a modest brass chape, worn suspended from a leather baldric crossing his chest over the quilted coat.

ref_desc: Jayachandra of Kannauj is a mid-40s, tall, medium-brown North Indian king with an oval face, neat moustache-beard, dark eyes, a low maroon turban over tied-back hair, wearing a deep indigo quilted coat over cream garments with mail and steel plate, crimson waist-sash, brown leather boots, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a straight steel khanda in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Jayachandra of Kannauj as a dignified late 12th-century North Indian king on campaign: a mid-40s, tall, solidly built man with a medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, dark intense eyes, and a neatly trimmed moustache and short beard; his dark brown-black hair is pulled into a low knot mostly hidden under a plain, close-fitting maroon cloth turban with a narrow gold band at its base. He wears a knee-length deep indigo quilted cotton coat with visible vertical stitching, open slightly at the front hem to reveal a cream long-sleeved kurta and straight off-white ankle-length trousers, with a fitted grey mail shirt and a simple polished steel breast-plate hinted beneath and over the coat; a broad crimson patka-sash wraps his waist with its ends hanging at the left hip, and he has plain brown leather mid-calf boots. Show small gold stud earrings, a thin gold neck-chain just peeking at the collar, and an iron signet ring on his right hand, keeping the jewellery understated. His signature weapon is a straight steel khanda-like sword with slightly widening tip, simple iron cross-guard and disc pommel in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass chape, hanging from a leather baldric crossing his chest; pose him calmly resolute, ensuring the deep indigo, crimson, cream, brown leather and steel grey palette is clear and consistent from head to toe.
